title: Portal document pane and ONLYOFFICE editing
description:
Build a chat-side document pane for vault documents, then add ONLYOFFICE editing for Office-family files when the storage and licensing contracts are ready.

Product goal:
- Chat stays usable while a right-side document pane opens for the document under discussion.
- DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, and PDF render in the pane.
- Human users can edit Office files through ONLYOFFICE after the write path is proven.
- Agent work appears as progress and refreshed document checkpoints. The agent does not pretend to live-type as a browser co-author.

Current baseline:
- Portal web already has chat, vault previews, vault citations, and tool progress.
- BFF vault routes are read-only.
- Brain RPC vault.write exists only as an optional placeholder.
- vault.read is a small JSON/base64 API and is not the production path for large Office files.

Non-goals for this epic:
- ONLYOFFICE Cloud as the production default.
- Automation API as the primary agent authoring path.
- Replacing lightweight client previews for ordinary read-only viewing.
- Allowing agents to overwrite a file while a human has an active dirty edit session.

## Required Skills
pstack-playbooks,how,architect
design:
pstack Feature playbook. Use these principles when implementing: foundational thinking, model-the-domain, boundary discipline, type-system discipline, separate-before-serializing-shared-state, make-operations-idempotent, experience-first, sequence-verifiable-units, and prove-it-works.

Design stance:
- Ship pane UX first with existing previews.
- Keep ONLYOFFICE as the human editor.
- Keep agent authoring headless through file-writing skills and vault writes.
- Treat BFF Office endpoints as the only storage boundary Document Server can reach.
- Do not route production Office files through the existing small-file vault/content preview endpoint.
acceptance_criteria:
[ ] Chat can open a vault document beside the thread without switching to the Vault tab.
[ ] Agent progress events can open, update, and refresh the pane for file work.
[ ] A typed document session model exists for pane state, artifact events, Office sessions, revisions, and conflicts.
[ ] Binary vault transfer and vault.write semantics are defined before production Office writeback.
[ ] ONLYOFFICE lab open, edit, save, and callback writeback pass for DOCX and XLSX.
[ ] Production license and Document Server topology decisions are recorded before staging deployment.
[ ] Security review covers signed download URLs, callbacks, JWT, ACL, retention, logs, and cross-tenant cache keys.
[ ] Staging E2E proves chat to agent write to pane refresh to human edit save.
notes:
